feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 May 2026 5:29am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 11 May 2026 at 5:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Weak weather front will quickly clear southwards through the Irish Sea today, with a northerly airstream following.


##Wind##

Northwest 5 occasionally 6, soon veering Northeast 4 or 5 this morning and then decreasing North or Northeast 3 or 4 later in the morning. Backing North or Northwest 3 or 4 in afternoon, occasionally 5 in north of area, then backing West tonight and increasing 4 or 5 in all waters.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight for a time later today.


##Weather##

Showery outbreaks of rain soon clearing, then fair before patchy light rain and drizzle later tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showery rain at first and rain and drizzle later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, then decreasing 4 or 5 again during afternoon. Increasing West or Northwest 5 or 6 overnight into Wednesday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy light rain and drizzle soon clearing to scattered showers, then more frequent showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain and drizzle at first and in showers.
